evidence: Both legs gate Stamphog on a single user: products/review_hog/backend/receivers.py:111-126 resolves one acting reviewer via _resolve_assigned_reviewer (task creator if assigned, else the first resolved reviewer, receivers.py:206-207) and checks only that user's stamphog_review_inbox_prs, and the webhook-leg resolver resolve_stamphog_acting_reviewer (receivers.py:151-156) does the same, which products/stamphog/backend/tasks/tasks.py:205-207 maps to opted_out=True. The PR body states the opposite contract four times ('at least one of the assigned users has stamphog_review_inbox_prs enabled', 'checks whether any assigned reviewer opted in', 'someone is still opted in', 'nobody is opted in'), and the user-facing copy matches the body rather than the code: the toggle reads 'Let Stamphog review your Inbox PRs' (products/review_hog/frontend/CodeReviewScene.tsx:1053-1056) where 'your Inbox' is the full suggested_reviewers set per receivers.py:162-164, and the GitHub dismissal comment _INBOX_OPT_OUT_DISMISS_MESSAGE (tasks.py:70-74, posted at tasks.py:897) claims 'No reviewer currently has stamphog inbox reviews enabled' even when a non-canonical assignee still is. The canonical-reviewer narrowing is justified for ReviewHog because one user's perspectives/validator drive the run (test_inbox_trigger.py:229-238), but Stamphog reads no per-user options (products/stamphog/backend/facade/api.py:136-142; the id is provenance only), so nothing in the code forces it, and every Stamphog test uses a single assignee (test_inbox_trigger.py:327,383) so the two-reviewer case has no coverage. Realistic inputs hit it: auto-start tasks are created by the GitHub-integration user who is never assigned (receivers.py:13-14), so the first listed reviewer's toggle silently decides for every other assignee. Not must_fix: the miss is fail-closed (no review runs, standing approvals are still dismissed), so no unreviewed approval or data exposure results, and CI is unaffected.
notes: I would drop this to not_an_issue if a maintainer confirms the acting-reviewer gate is the intended Stamphog contract and the PR body, toggle copy, and 'No reviewer currently has...' dismissal message are corrected to say so.
